_about: Presentation data for trophy sales (closed sales at or above `tier`). `context` is each sale's rank by price among MLS closed single-family sales in its village and year (raw_sales, queried 2026-11-17; 2026 is year to date). Specifications are from the MLS record, or from Patrick's own listing description where the MLS record is outside the seven-village database.

stories.heroAlt: The entrance front of 28 Aberdeen Court at dusk: a grey shingle-style house with white trim and lit windows.
stories.summary: A shingle-style house of 2017 on 2.4 fenced acres in Tarns of the Moor.
story: A shingle-style house built in 2017 at the end of Tarns of the Moor, a private court in Bannockburn. It stands on 2.4 fenced acres that face south, with a pool, a shingled pavilion and a stone terrace behind the house.
Inside are 12,290 square feet on three levels and five bedroom suites. I represented the seller.
stories.factsSource: Specifications are from the listing description.

I represented both the seller and the buyer.

stories.heroAlt: The entrance front of 1000 E. Illinois Road: a long white house with a tile roof and dark shutters across a lawn.
stories.summary: A Mediterranean house of 1914 on 3.81 acres.
story: Built in 1914 in the Mediterranean manner: white walls, a tile roof, an arcade at the motor court and a formal parterre behind the house. The property is 3.81 acres in east Lake Forest.
The house has 6,268 square feet and six bedrooms. It went under contract in 37 days. I represented the seller.

story: A brick and stone house of 2001 on W. Kennicott Drive in Lake Forest, with four bedrooms, a billiard room and a wine cellar on the lower level, and gardens on three-quarters of an acre.
It went under contract in three days. I represented the seller.

stories.heroAlt: 611 Oak Knoll Drive from above the drive: a long pale house with a dark roof, arched dormers and a columned porch, set among mature trees.
stories.summary: A 1966 house on 1.4 acres, sold above the asking price in five days.
story: A house of 1966 on 1.4 acres on Oak Knoll Drive in Lake Forest, with five bedrooms, a pergola terrace with an outdoor fireplace, and a garden that runs back into the trees.
It went under contract in five days and closed above the asking price. I represented the seller.

stories.heroAlt: 530 Oak Knoll Drive in autumn: a grey shingled house with steep gables behind a curving walk, a red maple at the door and a yellow maple beside it.
stories.summary: A shingled house of 1991 on an acre and a half.
story: A grey shingled house of 1991 on an acre and a half on Oak Knoll Drive in Lake Forest, with four bedrooms and a glass-gabled great room built around a stone fireplace.
It was listed at the end of December and went under contract in March. I represented the seller.

story: A brick and clapboard house of 1990 in Arbor Ridge in Lake Forest, with five bedrooms, an octagonal cedar sunroom and a deck that looks over a pond.
It went under contract in four days. I represented the seller.
